Subject: Nebula vendor onboarding — invoice routing and accelerated settlement enrollment

Hi Erin,

Thanks again for agreeing to onboard with Redwood. Attached are our standard vendor onboarding form and W9 — could you complete and return when you have a moment? A couple of items we need to finalize to complete the setup: 

- Preferred invoice delivery lane (email vs. AP portal)
- PO requirements and whether invoices need PO number on each line
- Payment terms: Nebula requested Net 45 in prior conversations; we wanted to confirm if you'd like to be enrolled in our accelerated settlement program (early pay) — we can offer 1% early pay for Net 15 or 0.5% for Net 30 based on monthly volume.

Estimate for Nebula invoices is ~ $48k/month initially (ramping). If you want the accelerated option, please indicate which speed (Net 15/Net 30) and provide the AP contact and sample invoice.

Attachments: nebula_onboarding_form.pdf, W9_nebula.pdf

Next steps from our side: once we receive the completed form and AP sample, I’ll route to Finance for approval and provisioning of a PO and the AP email to use.

Best,

Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference

Subject: Approval request: Nebula accelerated settlement (0.75%)

Hey Ben/Laura,

Quick ask — Nebula (account DL-7892) has requested enrollment in our early-pay program at 0.75% for Net 15, while keeping Net 30 as the nominal term. They’re ~ $48k/mo. Our standard threshold for the 0.75% tier is $25k+/mo, so they qualify on volume. 

Impact considerations:
- Estimated cost to Redwood (discount expense) at 0.75% on $48k/month ≈ $360/month — immaterial vs. retention value.
- Requires a separate AP routing mailbox so finance can flag and process early-pay runs (suggested: AP-early@redwoodinference.com).
- Procurement needs a PO template (PO-RED-YYYY-####) for their invoices to match.

Approve? If yes, confirm the PO numbering, GL code to use (we commonly use 5-4100 for vendor services), and whether Legal needs any additional redlines on the vendor agreement.

Thanks,
Rishi Malhotra
Head of Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

Rishi — approved. Good fit. Confirming the following:

- Approve enrollment at 0.75% early-pay (Net 15) with Net 30 as base term.
- Set up dedicated AP routing: ap-early@redwoodinference.com (IT to provision; please include a JIRA ticket to create mailbox and routing rule).
- PO numbering: PO-RED-2027-4827 (please use for all Nebula invoices).
- GL code: 5-4100 (vendor services).

No additional Legal redlines required for the early-pay clause beyond the standard vendor addendum; Legal should receive the redline but it’s low risk.

Ben Carter

Redwood Inference
